label: lem:integral_base_zero
title: Integral from a point to itself is zero
statement: For any function $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and any $a \in \mathbb{R}$, $\int_a^a f(t)\,dt = 0$. In Mathlib this is \texttt{intervalIntegral.integral\_same}.
proof: This is a standard Mathlib result (\texttt{intervalIntegral.integral\_same}). The interval $[a,a]$ has zero length, so the integral vanishes.
